verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's own marketing claims two in-product capabilities that fit this story. It offers "AI-suggested Modifications" for fixing missing punches, which are suggestions drawn from time data. Its "Intelligent Pay Cycle" flags payroll issues before they cause delays. Both are narrow, single-line marketing claims, and AI-powered compliance Q&A is adjacent rather than insight from the customer's own data. Missing for 10: broad AI-generated insights across payroll and HR data, in-depth first-party documentation of how the suggestions work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
